name: nachlielp-skills
description: Agent Skills for Claude Code: the pink PostHog design system and the Convex + Clerk + Vercel PWA stack.

plugins.name: pink-posthog
plugins.description: A house design system for polished UIs: pink paper background, extrabold Archivo headings, white cards with hard offset shadows, chunky 3D press-down buttons, and a selectable accent. Ships plain CSS, a Tailwind v4 @theme setup, and a themed React component library.

plugins.name: convex-clerk-pwa
plugins.description: Build or retrofit a production React + Vite PWA on Convex, Clerk and Vercel — with web-push notifications and a versioning system that keeps the app cached offline yet never serves a stale build after deploy.
